verdict.rationale: Mercury ships a CLI, an MCP server and a web dashboard, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. No evidence item mentions telemetry, analytics or any opt-out control. Revoking access tokens and scoped API permissions are adjacent security features, not telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
